resume: PERF-1 is a performance firmware: ten genres of self-playing music that you steer as it goes, with auto-DJ, drum sequencer, an acid line that answers itself and DX7-style FM voices.

commandes.role: Octave down: the page's voice, or the whole song elsewhere; in the sequencer, previous drum kit; in the FX menu, turn everything off.
Octave up, in the same way; in the sequencer, next drum kit.
Opens or closes the effects menu; twice quickly, the settings of the last effect.
Pad page; then Pad env, Pad LFO, Chords.
Drone page; then Drone env, Drone LFO.
Next chord, at the next bar.
Global page (root, theme, tuning, MIDI out). Held, the map of mutes, solos and scenes.
Tempo page; then the Perform screen; twice quickly, the visualizers.
Breakdown at the next bar; once more, a four-bar build and drop. On Global, stores the song.
Acid page; then Acid env, Acid line, Pluck.
Drums page; held, the sequencer whose white keys are the 16 steps.
Freeze: the chord holds and the reverb rings, until the next press.
Goes through the pages in order.

gestes: SEL held + PRESETS: the song changes at the next bar.
